conventions: values are unrounded; differences are taken before rounding
printed: fixed decimals as in the current paper; times and speedups with 1 decimal below 10, else 0; a trailing '?' marks a provisional value
claims: result null = undetermined (missing data); 'noise' fields give z = difference / (pooled E5 seed SD * sqrt(2/n_runs_per_mean))
paper locations refer to the paper sources as of the 2026-10-30 audit
